attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-api as a managed systemd service on node1 with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, giving it near-total OOM immunity. Verified that a deliberately unprotected memory-hog process (default oom_score_adj=0) drives the system out of memory and gets selected/killed by the kernel OOM killer, while inventory-api keeps serving reads and writes uninterrupted (same PID throughout, data intact). Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured a boot_id baseline, issued systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified inventory-api (enabled, active, data intact, OOM protection reapplied on the new PID) recovered, with the mem-hog test service remaining disabled/inert.
